title: [Bug]: Crash on TaskTrackingAction plan first call
body:
### Is there an existing issue for the same bug? (If one exists, thumbs up or comment on the issue instead).

- [x] I have checked the existing issues.

### Describe the bug and reproduction steps


Please note I have used the same settings about three times in a row without any problems. I was had started up new cli session and it crashed trying to setup the task list. 

The error was: 

```
Agent running... (Press Ctrl-P to pause)

Great! I can see we have 9 release tags on the bitbucket remote. Now let me check what tags already exist on the GitHub remote:

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────| Command |─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│$ git ls-remote --tags origin                                                                                                                                               │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────| Command Output |─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                                                                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Agent running... (Press Ctrl-P to pause)
17:02:49 - openhands:ERROR: base.py:366 - [runtime 627d22d3-e8bb-4b-2b5ffa8596dcbb8] Unexpected error while running action: AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get'
17:02:49 - openhands:ERROR: base.py:367 - [runtime 627d22d3-e8bb-4b-2b5ffa8596dcbb8] Problematic action: TaskTrackingAction(command='plan', task_list=['Check current remotes and tags', 'Fetch tags from bitbucket remote', 'Create matching tags on origin/github remote', 'Push all tags to origin', 'Verify tags are properly created on GitHub'], thought='Perfect! The GitHub remote (`origin`) has no tags at all, so we need to migrate all 9 tags from bitbucket to GitHub. Let me use the task tracker to organize this work:', action=<ActionType.TASK_TRACKING: 'task_tracking'>)
17:02:49 - openhands:ERROR: loop.py:24 - AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get'

Perfect! The GitHub remote (origin) has no tags at all, so we need to migrate all 9 tags from bitbucket to GitHub. Let me use the task tracker to organize this work:
ERROR:asyncio:Task exception was never retrieved
future: <Task finished name='Task-18602' coro=<run_session.<locals>.on_event_async() done, defined at /Users/consensussolutions/.cache/uv/archive-v0/PxPGezAo_67BS4rP9WVLO/lib/python3.12/site-packages/openhands/cli/main.py:209> exception=AttributeError("'str' object has no attribute 'get'")>
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/Users/consensussolutions/.cache/uv/archive-v0/PxPGezAo_67BS4rP9WVLO/lib/python3.12/site-packages/openhands/cli/main.py", line 211, in on_event_async
    display_event(event, config)
  File "/Users/consensussolutions/.cache/uv/archive-v0/PxPGezAo_67BS4rP9WVLO/lib/python3.12/site-packages/openhands/cli/tui.py", line 276, in display_event
    display_task_tracking_action(event)
  File "/Users/consensussolutions/.cache/uv/archive-v0/PxPGezAo_67BS4rP9WVLO/lib/python3.12/site-packages/openhands/cli/tui.py", line 540, in display_task_tracking_action
    status = task.get('status', 'unknown')
             ^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get'
⚠️ Session was interrupted: error

```



### OpenHands Installation

CLI

### OpenHands Version

0.54.0

### Model Name

together_ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct

### Operating System

MacOS

### Logs, Errors, Screenshots, and Additional Context

I have been using the following setup for half a day with no problems: 

```
% env | grep LLM
LLM_API_KEY=xxxx
LLM_MODEL=openai/kimi-k2
LLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000
```

The model is is US hosted Kimi K2 (as its open weights). The hosting is Together.Ai. I am running via litellm proxy as OH does not like the direct API. Here is the poxy config: 

```
model_list:
  - model_name: kimi-k2
    litellm_params:
      model: together_ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct
      api_key: "xxxx"
    model_info:
      max_tokens: 4096
      max_input_tokens: 128000
      max_output_tokens: 4096
      input_cost_per_token: 0.000001
      output_cost_per_token: 0.000003
      litellm_provider: together_ai
      mode: chat
      supports_function_calling: true
      supports_parallel_function_calling: false
      supports_vision: false

litellm_settings:
  set_verbose: true
  drop_params: true
```

linked_prs.title: fix: validate `task_list` schema for task tracker
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/openhands/agenthub/codeact_agent/function_calling.py b/openhands/agenthub/codeact_agent/function_calling.py
index ca0c221bdacb..34875645bdd7 100644
--- a/openhands/agenthub/codeact_agent/function_calling.py
+++ b/openhands/agenthub/codeact_agent/function_calling.py
@@ -263,9 +263,36 @@ def response_to_actions(
                         f'Missing required argument "task_list" for "plan" command in tool call {tool_call.function.name}'
                     )
 
+                raw_task_list = arguments.get('task_list', [])
+                if not isinstance(raw_task_list, list):
+                    raise FunctionCallValidationError(
+                        f'Invalid format for "task_list". Expected a list but got {type(raw_task_list)}.'
+                    )
+
+                # Normalize task_list to ensure it's always a list of dictionaries
+                normalized_task_list = []
+                for i, task in enumerate(raw_task_list):
+                    if isinstance(task, dict):
+                        # Task is already in correct format, ensure required fields exist
+                        normalized_task = {
+                            'id': task.get('id', f'task-{i + 1}'),
+                            'title': task.get('title', 'Untitled task'),
+                            'status': task.get('status', 'todo'),
+                            'notes': task.get('notes', ''),
+                        }
+                    else:
+                        # Unexpected format, raise validation error
+                        logger.warning(
+                            f'Unexpected task format in task_list: {type(task)} - {task}'
+                        )
+                        raise FunctionCallValidationError(
+                            f'Unexpected task format in task_list: {type(task)}. Each task shoud be a dictionary.'
+                        )
+                    normalized_task_list.append(normalized_task)
+
                 action = TaskTrackingAction(
                     command=arguments['command'],
-                    task_list=arguments.get('task_list', []),
+                    task_list=normalized_task_list,
                 )
 
             # ================================================
